name: navbar-floating
title: Floating navbar
description: A rounded bar that floats clear of the page edges, with a highlight that slides to the link you hover or the page you are on.
docs: Pass brand, flat items ({ label, href }), actions and currentHref. The pill is solid and bordered, centred with space on every side, and sticky by default so the page scrolls behind it; give it a negative bottom margin (className="-mb-[4.5rem]") when the hero should sit behind it. One highlight follows hover and focus along the links and settles on the current page when they leave; it is measured from the link boxes, so it fits any label, and under reduced motion it jumps instead of sliding. On a phone the pill shrinks to the brand and a menu button, and the links open as a panel under it: a disclosure closed by Escape, a click outside or choosing a link. linkAs renders the links with your router's Link, so a Server Component can use the bar.
